sam: Quick thread  need a trimmed battlecard for the benchmark webinar: one-pager + 60s pitch.
lina: I can draft the 60s pitch. Focus: predictable unit costs, stable tail latency, same API across deployments.
marc: Evidence: internal runs show observed reductions up to ~50% token cost on sustained 8k-token traces when prefix caching + routing enabled. Mark as 'internal tests'.
zoe: Sales wants 3 rebut bullets vs each competitor bucket (Cloud AI, LLM APIs, Infra). I'll pair with one-line plays.
ops-bot: Suggested routing tag for webinar leads: {"lead_source":"bench-webinar","interest":"trial_or_dedicated"} -> SDR or AE based on score.
sam: Keep language cautious: use 'observed' and include methodology slide. Also add a transparency slide with sampling counts.
lina: I'll produce the AE script and one-pager by EOD. Marc please confirm numbers.
marc: Will validate and attach bench summary.
zoe: We'll run a 15-min playtest with 3 AEs after draft.
sam: Perfect. No blockers.
